tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Workspace canvas behind every panel. Never put body text directly on it except page headers.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Opaque panels, inspector, dialogs, materialized graph nodes.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Graph lanes, table header rows, code excerpts, neutral chips.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav items and nodes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary content on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting metadata, type labels, future-obligation text. Reads 4.5:1 on bg, surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Quiet structure: panel edges, row dividers. Decorative only — never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: dashed future-obligation nodes, control outlines, inactive edges. 3:1 on surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: active
tokens.usage: Selection outline, running state, current lifecycle stage, links, focus ring.

tokens.name: active-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind active chips, the current-stage ribbon cell and the highlighted lane.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Passed conditions, recorded / approved / released states. Always paired with a word and glyph.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind success chips.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Waiting, review required, blocked, missing evidence, inference awaiting review.

tokens.name: attention-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind attention chips and the attention strip marker.

tokens.name: failure
tokens.usage: Failure evidence, failed attempts, denied tool actions, rejected decisions.

tokens.name: failure-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind failure chips.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary command per view (Open contextual detail, Approve).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Context edges outside the selected neighbourhood. Decorative; the selected neighbourhood uses edge-strong.

tokens.name: edge-strong
tokens.usage: Edges in the selected neighbourhood or active lens, and their arrowheads.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and drawers.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page / cycle title. One per screen.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Overview truth tiles only — release, index, counts with denominators.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A writable attempt is admitted only after dependencies, versions, scope and policy pass.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase object-type labels and column headers. Smallest size allowed.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Entity IDs, versions, relation types on nodes and in tables.

styles.name: sha
styles.usage: Commit SHAs, snapshot hashes, timestamps, routes.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code excerpts and typed command previews.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Base unit. Gap between nodes in a lane, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Node padding, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding (compact), gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding (default), page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Separation between page header and workspace.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Status, provenance and SHA chips.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, graph nodes.

tokens.name: radius-surface
tokens.usage: Panels, lanes, dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers and popovers only. Panels use borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Navigation rail. Wide enough for a monogram and an 11px label.

tokens.name: inspector-width
tokens.usage: Object inspector / context column on desktop (≥1280px).

tokens.name: lane-min-width
tokens.usage: Minimum control-plane lane width before the graph switches to scroll or list mode. Never shrink the graph to fit.
